clips.title: The story
paras: In the Valley of Trials, Gornek oversees new orc and Darkspear troll recruits in Durotar. He receives those preparing to prove their worth to the New Horde.

At the Valley of Trials, Gornek puts new Horde recruits through their first test of discipline. Warchief Thrall's order is clear: every youth and newcomer must earn a place through grit and perseverance. Gornek assesses those entering the valley, reads their introductory orders, and directs them to trainers around the compound. Whether an initiate carries an encrypted scrawl, a glyphic parchment, or a simple tablet, Gornek receives the credentials and sends them onto a harsh path of survival.

The valley's arid canyons test battle skill and teach the New Horde's communal ways. Gornek keeps novices from lingering aimlessly, pointing them toward nearby scorpid burrows, feral boar dens, and veteran instructors. Those who survive the training grounds and slay the threats in the red rock gullies receive Gornek's final acknowledgment before he sends them out into Durotar's wider, perilous landscape.
